finalists.label: Stargardt disease
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including symmetric hypoautofluorescent lesions with hyperautofluorescent borders in the central macula bilaterally and thinning of the outer nuclear layer in the fovea.

finalists.label: Macular dystrophy
finalists.why: It explains the central scotoma and the FAF imaging results, and has no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most specific and decisive findings, including the FAF imaging results and the OCT findings, which are not fully explained by the runner-up.
